items.title: Article: From Microservices to Agents: The Next Evolution of Distributed Systems
items.blurb: The article examines the transition from microservices to agentic AI architecture in distributed systems. Microservices allow for functional decomposition, while agentic systems focus on decision decomposition.

items.title: Podcast: The Future of Web Apps: Will AI Agents Generate UIs on the Fly?
items.blurb: Rachel Lee Nabors, former React core team member, dives into the architecture and philosophy behind local-first applications, exploring how small language models (SLMs) running directly on-device can deliver privacy-focused, low-latency,…

items.title: NestJS 12: ESM Packages, Standard Schema Validation and Native Observability
items.blurb: NestJS version 12 has been released, transitioning core packages to ESM and adding Standard Schema validation. It updates the CLI and introduces an observability SDK.
